name: cross-margin-edge
description:
Mid-range stress point between the canonical 10% crash (`cross-margin-survival`) and the deep 50% crash (`cross-margin-fail`). With ETH at 95 (5% crash), the demo's fixed perp position is already deeply siloed-LIQUIDATABLE — the perp's initial-margin requirement bites well before mark-vs-entry breakeven. Unified margin still has 380 USDC headroom, demonstrating that the netting envelope holds even with the perp leg under-water. Useful for showing how an IM-driven liquidation gate fires earlier than a naïve P&L formula suggests, and how cross-margin nets that early.

Tip: pass `--eth-crash-price <N>` on `scenario run` to dial through other crash depths without editing this JSON — the v2 path applies the override before invoking the in-process demo.
headline: At ETH = 95 (5% crash), the IM-driven gate already marks the perp leg liquidatable; unified margin still has ~380 USDC headroom.

steps.explanation: Run lending-demo at the mid-stress crash point. Output shows siloed already deeply negative because of the IM check; unified still positive thanks to lending collateral netting against the perp loss.
